title: Accelerating the next wave of intelligent innovation with NVIDIA and Google Cloud
description: AI is transforming every industry, and NVIDIA and Google Cloud are delivering the foundation for it. By combining NVIDIA’s performance-optimized accelerated computing stack with Google Cloud’s AI platform - including Google Kubernetes Engine, Vertex AI, Cloud Run, and Google Distributed Cloud - we’re enabling enterprises, startups, and developers to train and serve frontier models, power agentic AI applications, accelerate analytics, and run industrial and physical AI at scale - across all models, modalities, and workloads, to solve real business challenges and build new products.
